2026-10-14.title: A little note for today
2026-10-14.message: Yaar, never thought of putting a message 😔 ? Aur aapne tho kaha tha ki you'll be listening to you heart.

2026-10-15.title: Lost in you and healed by him
2026-10-15.message: Could you make my little universe more brighter with just one hello?        •Being far from you, I lost my self. A part of my heart became against to you, why? My heart wants to meet you, why does it want to meet you? Like the glow of stars, light up this night. Explain to my heart, keep your hand in mine. What I've never seen before, show me such a world.

2026-10-16.title: Day by Day, it's only you
2026-10-16.message: Aaj bhi uthna hee anxiety to with you when I saw you the first. And har din meri admiration aap ke liye is growing more and more, endlessly._.

2026-10-17.title: That ✨ eye contact:) ufff🤌🏼
2026-10-17.message:
Saari raat aahein bharta, Pal Pal yaadonein marta, maane na meri mann mera......

Khwahish hai ki only we both only will exist in this little place (hope 🤞🏼 you wouldn't share the key with anyone😟). UMMEED HAI, MERA BHAROSA TUMHARE PAAS SURAKSHITH RAHEGI._.

2026-10-18.title: Just a few little hopes, left to you
2026-10-18.message: Ho sakhe tho just a 'hello'. Today nothing very much, so just saying 'Good Night🪽', literally since many days these little words left unsaid to the very special 💖 person. If you'd like, enjoy the music._.
